Session date: 1:45 pm on 6 August, 2022
[D18:7] John: Your support means a lot. Lately, I've been thinking about what truly makes me happy, and I'm really drawn to the gaming industry. I'm passionate about it and it's time to turn that into a career. I want to become an organizer of tournaments for various computer games in our state. For example, for CS:GO. It's a new journey for me.
[D18:8] James: Cool! You always mentioned your love for gaming. What other game do you want to organize competitions for? And what`s your plan now?
[D18:9] John: Also, I can host Fortnite competitions. I have already made some connections that will help me with this. My plan is to gain more experience and perfect my skills to be successful in this field.
[D18:10] James: Sounds like a solid plan! Trying out different game genres can be a great way to widen your skills and knowledge.
[D18:11] John: Thanks! I am very glad that you support me in my new endeavor!
[D18:12] James: I will always be here for you! If you need any financial assistance or advice, please contact me!
[D18:13] John: I will definitely do this if necessary! By the way, what's new with you?
[D18:13] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a desk with a computer monitor and keyboard
[D18:14] James: Yesterday I took my puppy to the clinic.
[D18:15] John: God, James, what happened to your puppy? Is it OK?
[D18:16] James: Don't worry. This was just a routine examination. Also, the puppy was vaccinated to prevent him from catching the seasonal canine disease.
[D18:17] John: Phew, great that he's okay. It's great that you care so much about your pets!
[D18:18] James: They are the source of my joy, so I will always take care of them!
[D18:19] John: You're a great host, James! Well, I have to go, bye!
[D18:20] James: Thanks, John! Take care, bye!
Session date: 9:16 am on 10 August, 2022

[D19:5] John: Hooked a new RPG that I've been playing lately! The storytelling and characters are amazing, can't get enough of it.
[D19:6] James: Sounds great! I think storytelling is what makes RPGs so fun. What game are you playing? Do you have any favorite characters?
[D19:7] John: I'm playing "The Witcher 3"! There's this awesome monster hunter with a cool story, and I'm totally hooked, trying to make the right choices to shape the world. It's really immersive.
[D19:8] James: Yeah, "The Witcher 3" is amazing! I love how you can shape the world with your choices and feel the impact. The graphics are insane too - check out this pic.
[D19:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a man dressed in armor holding a sword
[D19:9] John: That's a great pic! The graphics are truly stunning! By the way, look how I organized my workplace!
[D19:9] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a gaming room with a computer and a gaming chair
[D19:10] James: Cool! Wall lighting adds beauty to your workspace.
[D19:11] John: Thanks James! What's new with you?
[D19:12] James: Yesterday I took my three dogs to a beach outing to have fun and bond with other dogkeepers.
[D19:13] John: Cool! Surely you gained a new experience from communicating with other dog lovers!
[D19:13] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a refrigerator with a calendar on it and a magnet
[D19:14] James: Yes, we had fun and I even met one beautiful girl. I'm thinking of asking her out on a date! She left me her phone number, I think I'll call tomorrow.
[D19:15] John: Wow! That's cool, what's her name? Be sure to call her, everything will work out!
[D19:16] James:  She is Samantha. I'll definitely call her!
[D19:17] John: Yoohoo! Hope you have a wonderful time!
Session date: 3:57 pm on 21 August, 2022
[D20:1] John: Hey, James! Good to hear from you. I have some awesome news - I joined a programming group online last Friday and it's been incredible! It's awesome to be part of a community of people with similar goals - coding and making a difference.
[D20:2] James: Hey John! That's great to hear! Being part of a coding community can definitely be rewarding. Can you share more about your experiences with the online group? Have you made any interesting connections?
[D20:3] John: Thanks for asking. My online programming group has been great - lots of skilled coders, all passionate about using tech for good. We've shared ideas, chatted about coding and worked on a few projects together. It's amazing to see everyone's different skills and viewpoints. I've even exchanged contacts with a few of them.
[D20:4] James: Nice one, John! Looks like you're really getting involved in the programming world. It's great connecting with like-minded people and building up your network. Have you had the opportunity to collaborate on any projects or work with anyone yet?
[D20:5] John: Yeah, collaborating is great. Last week I worked with someone from the group on a project and we both had our strong points which helped out. It was cool seeing how we created something awesome together. It's great working with others.
[D20:6] James: Working together on a project can create amazing results, when everyone brings in their different strengths and abilities. It's cool when the final product is done and you know you were a part of making something awesome. Can we say that you are returning to working with programming again?
[D20:7] John: I think not, this is just a one-time experience to learn something new and work as a team. I'm still full of courage to start hosting eSports competitions. Do you participate in any online groups?
[D20:8] James: Nah, not in any online groups right now, but I do have my gaming group I play with regularly. We even stream our game sessions, and recently had a get-together. Super fun!
[D20:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a gaming room with a computer and a gaming chair
[D20:9] John: Wow, James! That's great that you have some friends to game with. By the way, I bought some new devices and refurbished my gaming desk.
[D20:9] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a desk with a computer and a keyboard
[D20:10] James: Cool! What kind of gear do you have now for gaming? I have a setup with a gaming PC, keyboard, mouse, and a comfy chair - makes gaming for hours a lot more bearable!
[D20:10] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a gaming desk with a computer and a gaming chair
[D20:11] John: Nice set-up, James! I have a similar gaming chair and keyboard. I'm currently using a gaming PC with a powerful graphics card for intense games. I also have a headset for immersive sound. Gaming has always been an awesome escape for me - it keeps me focused and motivated in other areas.
[D20:12] James: Nice one! A strong graphics card and headset really enhance the gaming experience. Yeah, gaming is a great way to escape and stay motivated. It takes us to different places and stories. I even hosted a gaming marathon with some friends and we had a blast. We played all night and it really strengthened our bond.
[D20:12] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a family sitting on a couch in a living room
[D20:13] John: Sounds great! Gaming marathons are the best. When I was younger, my siblings threw me one and it was awesome! We stayed up all night playing games and it really bonded us.
[D20:13] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two children sitting on a couch with a baby
[D20:14] James: Wow, that sounds awesome! Do you still play with your siblings these days?

Session date: 5:00 pm on 11 May, 2022
[D11:19] John: Thanks, James! Appreciate it. Take care and talk soon!
Session date: 7:33 pm on 23 May, 2022
[D12:1] James: Hey John, last weekend I had an awesome time at the amusement park with my friends. It was a great break from the virtual world. I went on some awesome roller coasters and it reminded me of when I was a kid. Everything was so real and exciting; it felt like I was in a video game!
[D12:2] John: Hey James! Sounds like an awesome time! I bet those rides brought back some great memories. Were there any other attractions besides the roller coaster?
[D12:3] James: Of course, I also managed to ride the Ferris wheel, electric cars and buggies. What's new with you?
[D12:4] John: That's really cool! Last Friday I entered a local tournament and took second place! It was a wild experience and the competitive energy was insane.
[D12:5] James: Wow, John that's awesome! Congrats on your achievement! I can imagine the rush you must have felt during the tournament. Did you receive any rewards or prizes for your success?
[D12:6] John: I was stoked about my achievement. Though I didn't win the tournament, I still received some money for the 2nd place. Seeing my effort pay off was awesome.
[D12:7] James: Awesome news! You don't have to win every time, growth and progress are most important. 
[D12:8] John: Yeah, I also got this trophy! So satisfying. It reminds me to always put in my best effort. What about you? Any success stories lately?
[D12:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a graduation cap on a book with a rope
[D12:9] James: Congrats on your achievement, John! That trophy looks awesome. Last month, I had a personal milestone. There were definitely tough times, but it reminds me of all the hard work. I feel a huge sense of accomplishment and I'm ready for the future opportunities!
[D12:10] John: Congrats on the milestone. What was it and what made it challenging? What did you learn?
[D12:11] James: I finished a big project I had been working on for months. It was challenging because I had to learn a new language and handle many details. I learned a lot about problem-solving, patience, and perseverance. Now I feel more confident to take on even bigger projects.
[D12:12] John:  That's awesome you learned a language and handled all those details. Great job, you definitely picked up some great skills! Remember, determination and confidence make any project a success. Good work!
[D12:13] James: Thanks, I appreciate your support. I'll definitely keep that in mind.
[D12:14] John: No worries, I'm here to help. Keep going and reach those goals!
Session date: 4:30 pm on 13 June, 2022
[D13:1] John: Hey James, long time no talk! A lot has happened during this time. Let me fill you in.
[D13:2] James: Hey John! Awesome to hear from you. Yeah, a lot has happened. Let's catch up!
[D13:3] John: I finally got my dream job! After lots of interviews and late nights, I got the offer and was ecstatic. Can't wait to start my journey!
[D13:4] James: Wow, John! Congrats on getting your dream job. I'm super stoked for you. When do you start?
[D13:5] John: Thank you! ! I'm starting next month.
[D13:6] James: It can be rough getting started, but I'm sure you'll do great. Don't be afraid to seek help if you need it. Can't wait to hear about your experience! By the way, I recently started a course that combines my passion for gaming and programming. It's fun and challenging, and it has definitely increased my excitement for both.
[D13:7] John: Cool! That sounds awesome. Combining your love of gaming and coding sounds like a dream. Tell me more! Are there any interesting projects you're working on?
[D13:8] James: Yes, we are currently working on a new part of the football simulator. I was working on collecting player databases. It wasn't easy, but I did it!
[D13:9] John: Cool! Did you choose this course because you love football?
[D13:10] James: Not least because of this. I love football, but, of course, the most important reason is to improve yourself. But it’s nice if it’s also connected with something you like.
[D13:11] John: I completely agree! By the way, did you watch the Liverpool vs Chelsea match?
[D13:12] James: Of course, they played well! As I like to say, there is no sport better than football, no club better than Liverpool! I don't miss a single match of theirs!
[D13:13] John: It looks like you really root for this team!
[D13:14] James: Absolutely! They are forever in my heart, they are a great team. I hope they become champions next season!
[D13:15] John: As a Manchester City fan, I can't agree with you. You'll see, our two teams will fight for the championship, and mine will win!
[D13:16] James: I'm sure you're wrong, John. Manchester City are in bad form and their transfer policy is terrible!
[D13:17] John: You may be right, but the City manager can handle it, you'll see!
[D13:18] James: I bet we'll be higher than you in the final standings!
[D13:19] John: I'll take the bet, James! This will be a great battle!
[D13:20] James: Sure, John!
Session date: 5:07 pm on 16 June, 2022
[D14:1] James: Hey John, how's it going? A lot has happened for me lately, some good and some not so great. I`m lucky to have at least two people who always help me out when I'm struggling. What about you?
[D14:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a dog laying on a person on a couch
[D14:2] John: Gad to hear you have your support system ready. It's crucial, especially during hard times. For me, it's been quite an emotional rollercoaster. Last week, I started my blog about coding. It's exciting and kinda scary too. This is the first picture I uploaded there.
[D14:2] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a computer screen with a program on it

[D14:3] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a video game scene of a man and woman

[D14:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a book shelf with a few books on it
[D14:9] James: Cool! Are there any book series that you love and would recommend to others?

[D14:11] James: Thanks for the recommendations, John! I'll definitely check out those books. What makes them your favorites?
[D14:11] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a cd with a picture of a knight on it

passages.title: LoCoMo conv-47 history chunk 1
passages.text:
Session date: 3:47 pm on 17 March, 2022
[D1:1] John: Hey! Glad to finally talk to you. I want to ask you, what motivates you?
[D1:2] James: Hey John! Video games give me tons of joy and excitement, so they keep me motivated!
[D1:3] John: Cool, James! I'm a big video game fan too. They help me relax after a long day. What game are you currently enjoying the most?
[D1:4] James: I'm totally into The Witcher 3 right now. The story and atmosphere are amazing. Have you tried it yet?
[D1:5] John: Haven't played it yet, but I hear it's awesome. Gonna give it a go. BTW, just signed up for a programming class. Have you ever done any programming?
[D1:6] James: Programming is an awesome skill. I tried it out one in college and now it`s all my life. Good luck in the class! Do you have any coding experience?
[D1:7] John: I did a bit of coding in HTML and CSS a few years back. Thought I'd refresh those skills in this course. What languages do you like most and any projects you've done?
[D1:8] James: I've worked with Python and C++. I've built a website and also created some game mods. Here is one example.
[D1:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a computer screen showing a video game scene
[D1:9] John: That mod looks amazing! The graphics are awesome. What other programming languages have you worked with?
[D1:10] James: I haven’t worked with any other programming languages, but I hope to work in the future.
[D1:11] John: Maybe in the future we will develop mobile applications together? Do you like the idea?
[D1:12] James: It would be cool! For example, we could write some kind of application for dogs. By the way, my dogs.
[D1:12] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two dogs are tied to a fence with a leash
[D1:13] John: Aww, they're adorable! What are the names of your pets? And what are your plans for the app?
[D1:14] James: Max and Daisy. Will be actually cool to build an app for dog walking and pet care. The goal is to connect pet owners with reliable dog walkers and provide helpful information on pet care.
[D1:15] John: Sounds good, James! Bet that app would find a lot of buyers. What sets it apart from other existing apps?
[D1:16] James: Thanks, John! The personal touch really sets it apart. Users can add their pup's preferences/needs - just like they were customizing it for them. Making it unique for each owner and pup.
[D1:16] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a notepad with a handwritten note on it
[D1:17] John: That's a great idea! Your pup is gonna love it. Speaking of personal touches, what motivates you to work on your programming projects?
[D1:18] James: Creating something and seeing it come to life gives me a great sense of accomplishment. It's an amazing feeling. I write down all my goals in a notebook. It's very satisfying to check off each one when it's done.
[D1:18] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person holding a notebook with a list of things on it
[D1:19] John: What are you working on that has you feeling so accomplished?
[D1:20] James: I'm working on something I've wanted to do since I was a kid. Even as a child, I made some sketches of the main character. Back then I was just drawing comics, but now I want to turn it into a computer game. It's a project that has me really excited.
[D1:20] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a drawing of a girl in a plane
[D1:21] John: Wow, James! That's amazing. What made you decide to work on it and create your own game?
[D1:22] James: I'm always excited to combine my favorite passions: gaming and storytelling. It's great creating my own project and bringing my ideas to life, plus the challenge is really enjoyable!
[D1:23] John: That sounds really fulfilling! Combining your passions to make something new must be so exciting. Can't wait to see the outcome.
[D1:23] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a medical chart with instructions for the procedure
[D1:24] James: Thanks John! It's super exciting. I'll keep you updated on the progress. Perhaps, thanks to your knowledge of HTML, I'll invite you to help with some things in my game.
[D1:25] John: It will be great to work with you, James.
[D1:26] James: I'll be looking forward to it. By the way, yesterday I went bowling and got 2 strikes. I love bowling!
[D1:27] John: I'm sure you're very good at this. Unfortunately, I can’t share my love for him with you, my fingers are too big. Perhaps I should take up exercise, at least start going for a run in the morning. And I also don’t like bowling itself, to be honest.
[D1:28] James: It's a pity, it would be nice to go play with you one day.
[D1:29] John: Well, I'm sure we can do something else. We can play slot machines and arcades, for example.
[D1:30] James: The last time I played at the slot machines, I was so engrossed in the game that I didn't notice my wallet being taken out of my pocket. Sad story.
[D1:31] John: I'm sorry to hear it. Well, I'll be nearby, I'll look after your pockets.
[D1:32] James: Still, maybe we can try something different?
[D1:33] John: Heard about VR gaming? It's pretty immersive. We can try it together!
[D1:34] James: I tried it - it's crazy how real it feels! Have you given it a shot?
[D1:35] John: Tried it a few times, it's insane how immersive that experience can be. Can't wait to try it together with you.
[D1:36] James: Yeah, VR gaming is awesome! Let`s do it next Saturday!
[D1:37] John: Agreed, James!
Session date: 9:26 pm on 20 March, 2022
[D2:1] James: Hey John, something awesome happened since we talked. I made a game avatar and joined a new platform. It's so fun exploring and chatting with other gamers - it's a whole new adventure every time! I feel like I'm part of a super cool online community.
[D2:2] John: Hey James, awesome! Glad you're enjoying it and connecting with others. Building a community is really cool, especially when you meet people who enjoy the same things.
[D2:3] James: Thanks, John! Connecting with other gamers has been great! We've shared tips, strategies, and stories about gaming. It's amazing how it brings people together, regardless of their backgrounds.
[D2:4] John: That's incredible! It's so cool how gaming can bring people together and create a strong bond, regardless of their background.
[D2:5] James: Yeah, it's our shared language and passion. It's been a refuge for me in tough times.
[D2:6] John: Yeah, gaming always helps me escape stress. It's amazing how it calms me down during tough times.
[D2:7] James: Games are my go-to when I'm feeling overwhelmed. It's like therapy. I can relax, forget my troubles, and get lost in another world.
[D2:8] John: Gotcha. Gaming can be a great way to take a break and escape for a while. Anything new you've been into lately?
[D2:9] James: Lately, I've been checking out different styles of it. It's been fun to try something fresh and test myself in other ways. What about you, John? Any new hobbies recently?
[D2:10] John: I've been getting into a new hobby recently. I bought a metal detector and walk along the beaches looking for something worthwhile.
[D2:11] James: Interesting, John! Sounds like an awesome immersive experience. Already found something interesting?
[D2:12] John: Mostly just bottle caps, but a couple of times I found coins, and once even a gold ring.
[D2:13] James: Cool, I wish you good luck in this matter! By the way, I've got something to show you.
[D2:14] John: Show me what you've got! What is it?
[D2:15] James: Check out this pic of my best buds having a blast in the park. They've brought so much joy to my life. My two dogs are the best pals ever, right?
[D2:15] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two dogs running in a field with a ball in their mouth
[D2:16] John: They look like they're having a blast! Can they do any tricks?

Session date: 9:49 am on 22 July, 2022
[D17:1] John: Hi James! I just started playing chess to get better at strategy. I'm loving it! Have you ever tried it out?
[D17:2] James: Hey John! Yeah, I've played chess before. It's a game that really tests your strategy. It's great that you're enjoying it!
[D17:3] John: Yeah, chess is really fun! It's like solving an endless puzzle and always trying to outwit your opponent.
[D17:4] James: Yeah, it's tough, but fun when you figure it out. Do you play with friends or online?
[D17:5] John: I'm playing mostly online for now, but I also joined a chess club and practice with others. Here's a pic from an intense game I played lately.
[D17:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a chess board with a laptop on it
[D17:6] James: Wow, looks intense! What sparked your interest in chess?
[D17:7] John: I've always been drawn to strategy games and wanted to challenge myself. Plus, I believe chess can improve decision-making skills.
[D17:8] James: Great reason for playing chess - it will definitely help you develop your skills!
[D17:9] John: Thanks, James! I'm excited to see how playing chess can enhance my strategic thinking in everyday situations. Do you have any tips for improvement?
[D17:10] James: Definitely! Studying opening moves and strategies and analyzing your games to spot weaknesses are great ways to improve.
[D17:11] John:  I'll definitely look into that. Appreciate the advice!
[D17:12] James: No worries, John! Happy to help. Just let me know if there's anything else I can assist you with.
[D17:13] John:  Your support means a lot to me. You're a true friend! Remember this photo from elementary school?
[D17:13] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of children holding a skateboard
[D17:14] James: That looks fun. But I don’t remember at all under what circumstances we took this picture. What's the story behind it?
[D17:15] John: This is from when we were 10 and we were really into skateboarding. We had a group of friends who often go to the skate park with. We would help each other learn new tricks and have a great time. Those friends made the experience even better and their friendship meant a lot to us.
[D17:16] James: Indeed, I remember this moment. We loved skateboards back then, sometimes we even left class early to do it. I still like to go for a ride sometimes, and I even taught my dogs how to balance on it.
[D17:16] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a small dog standing on a skateboard
[D17:17] John: Wow! Do they enjoy it, or do you have to encourage them to play with the board?
[D17:18] James: They love it! They chase after it and run with it. It's a great way for them to get some exercise.
[D17:19] John: Wow, that's great! Keeping active and happy is great for both of you.
[D17:20] James: Yep! Staying active with them builds a strong bond and makes us both happy.
[D17:21] John: Yeah, the bond between us and our pets is amazing. They bring a lot of joy and love. It’s a pity that I don’t have pets, I’ll definitely get one someday. By the way, how was your trip?
[D17:21] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a cat laying on a bed with a stuffed animal
[D17:22] James: Everything went great! In addition, I even managed to get out to another country. The city of Nuuk, if you know. I stayed there quite a bit, but at least I had one more country to add to my bucket list!
[D17:23] John: This is awesome, James! Surely you brought a lot of impressions with you!
[D17:24] James: Certainly! And not only impressions, I also brought souvenirs. For both you and your Jill!
[D17:25] John: Thank you very much, Jill will be delighted!
[D17:26] James: You're welcome! By the way, look who came to see me!
[D17:26] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman and two dogs on a couch
[D17:27] John: Nice pic, James! Who are they?
[D17:28] James: That's my sister and my dogs. We were just chilling together yesterday, and they bring so much happiness to my life.
[D17:29] John: Wow, they look so happy! It's awesome that you get to spend time with your sister and your furry friends. The bond you have with them is really strong.
[D17:30] James: I'm blessed to have a close bond with my sister and our furry friends. We have a great time together, like a family!
[D17:31] John: Family and friends are really amazing, James. They show us so much love and joy. I'm grateful for the connection I have with my siblings. Things can be tough sometimes, but their support means everything to me.
[D17:32] James: Fully agreed! My sister and I were also near the ocean and watched such a wonderful sunset!
[D17:32] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard
[D17:33] John: Wonderful photo! It's amazing how you can capture a moment and capture it in a photograph.
[D17:34] James: Thanks, John! This is just a good shot, nothing more. I took a lot of shots yesterday and chose the best one to send to you.
[D17:35] John: Still, the photo is amazing!
[D17:36] James: I have to go, I'm tired over the last two days. Bye!
[D17:37] John: Take care, bye!
Session date: 1:45 pm on 6 August, 2022
[D18:1] John: Hey James, good catching up! Been a while huh? I made a huge call - recently left my IT job after 3 years. It was tough but I wanted something that made a difference. And now with this new job, I am happy about my decision. I am loving the new job!
[D18:2] James: Hey John! Great to hear from you. Leaving after 3 years is a big step - how did it feel?
[D18:3] John: At first, it was super scary, but I knew I had to make a change and focus on things that align with my values and passions.
[D18:4] James: Wow, John, that sounds really brave. I hope it brings you joy and satisfaction.
[D18:5] John: Thanks, James. It wasn't easy, but sometimes you gotta take a leap to follow your heart.
[D18:6] James: Taking risks pays off! Way to be brave. I'm proud of you!

Session date: 9:23 pm on 4 September, 2022
[D23:4] John: I'm glad you finally found someone other than dogs that brings you joy. Well done, you will succeed!
[D23:5] James: Thanks, John. She and I are going to a baseball game next Sunday, want to join? I'll show you what Samantha looks like.
[D23:6] John: Yeah! Let's do it. It'll be a fun experience!
[D23:7] James: Great. Well, what else is new in your life?
[D23:8] John: I bought some new gaming equipment to improve my skills. For example, new headphones.
[D23:9] James: Cool, which company did you choose? And what other devices did you buy?
[D23:10] John: I chose headphones from Sennheiser. Judging by the reviews, they have excellent sound. Also, I bought a mouse from Logitech.
[D23:11] James: Cool! I hope the new devices will improve your skill and you will play even better!
[D23:11] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a video game scene of a couple of people
[D23:12] John: I really hope so too. Well, do you have anything new besides the great news about you and Samantha?
[D23:13] James: Yes, two days ago I signed up for a cooking class. I never liked cooking, but I felt that I wanted to learn something new. At the first lesson we prepared several simple dishes. I got a great omelette the first time!
[D23:14] John: Cool! I’ve never heard of your desire to cook, you surprise me! How much do these cooking courses cost and what else did you cook there?
[D23:15] James: At only $10 per class, it's very cheap! Also, I made meringue there and they taught us how to make the dough.
[D23:16] John: Really cheap. It's great that you are always looking for a way to improve yourself!
[D23:17] James: Thanks for your support, John! I really appreciate it. I hope I can treat you to my creation once I learn a little more about cooking.
[D23:18] John: I look forward to it, James, you can do it!
[D23:19] James: Your words give me even more strength to pursue my new hobby!
[D23:20] John: That's why we are friends, to support each other! Well, I have to go, bye!
[D23:21] James: Take care, John, bye!
Session date: 6:02 pm on 18 September, 2022
[D24:1] John: Hey James! Long time no see! A lot's changed since we talked. I started getting into board games. I tried one last week and it turned out to be a lot of fun. What's new with you?
[D24:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a table with a laptop and a game on it
[D24:2] James: Hey John! Cool, what kind of board game is this? I had a lot to do all this time. And in order not to forget to do something, I started writing down everything I needed in a notebook.
[D24:2] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a notebook with writing on it sitting on a table
[D24:3] John: This game is called "Dungeons of the Dragon", very exciting! I'm really glad you're writing down what you need to do in a notebook. This will definitely help you not to forget anything! How did you come up with this idea? In general, where do you get ideas?
[D24:4] James: Thanks, John! I get them from various sources like books, movies, and even dreams.
[D24:5] John: Wow, dreams have inspired you? That's interesting. Have any specific dreams guided your ideas?
[D24:6] James: A few weeks ago I had this crazy dream that led to some creative ideas. It was so vivid I woke up with some interesting thoughts!
[D24:7] John: Wow, dreams can be so awesome! Are there any specific details you remember from that one?
[D24:8] James: I remember there was a medieval castle with its own labyrinth full of puzzles and traps. It felt like playing a video game in real life!
[D24:9] John: Wow, exploring a castle with puzzles and traps sounds awesome! Have you got any sketches or notes from that experience? I'd love to take a look!
[D24:10] James: Yep! I made some sketches and notes. Hang on, let me grab them.
[D24:10] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a notepad with a drawing of a guitar
[D24:11] John: Nice sketch! Do you like music, or is it related to your castle dream?
[D24:12] James: Thanks! Music is a big part of my life - nothing to do with castles though. What kind of music do you like? Do you play any instruments?
[D24:12] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a desk with a laptop, headphones, and a monitor
[D24:13] John: Cool! I'm into electronic and rock music. I used to play drums when I was younger, but haven't in a while. Do you play any instruments?
[D24:14] James: Yeah, rock's awesome! I used to play a guitar when I was younger but haven't in a while.
[D24:15] John: Playing drums when I was younger was a fun way to let off steam. Here's a photo of an old drum set I used to play on.
[D24:15] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a drum set up in a recording studio
[D24:16] James: Cool! Have you ever been in a band or just jammed with friends?
[D24:17] John: I've jammed with friends before, it was a lot of fun!
[D24:18] James: Sounds awesome! Jamming with friends is always a blast. Do you have any recordings or videos of those sessions?
[D24:19] John: Nah, it was more about the experience and the moment. No recordings or videos from the jams.
[D24:20] James: No problem! It's nice to just enjoy the experience without worrying about collecting videos or recordings. By the way, I started streaming games. No details yet, I hope everything works out.
[D24:21] John: I'll keep my fingers crossed for you! You will definitely succeed, I look forward to the details!
Session date: 8:56 pm on 20 September, 2022
[D25:1] John: Hey James, been a few days since we chatted. Lots of stuff goin' on in my life!
[D25:2] James: Hey John! What new has happened in your life?
[D25:3] John: Yesterday I started a new startup - portable smokers. Now, I’ve already welded one from metal. Do you think it looks good? How about you, any cool stuff happening?
[D25:3] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a fire burning in a metal pot on a street
[D25:4] James: Hey John, that looks great! Seeing it makes me think of campfires with pals. Last night I streamed a game and wow, was I blown away by all the nice comments from the gaming community. I felt so stoked and inspired to keep going. 
[D25:5] John: Woohoo, congrats James! That's awesome. Sounds like you're doing well. All your hard work is paying off, so keep it up!
[D25:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a card with a graduation cap on it
[D25:6] James: Thanks for the support, John! This made me think of such an exciting time. Any more big moments recently?
[D25:7] John: I just achieved a major career milestone - making my first mobile game! It's launching next month.
[D25:7] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a demonic demon flying in the air with a sword
[D25:8] James: Way to go, John! Congrats on achieving that major career milestone. Could you tell me more about it? Why didn’t you say before that you were creating a mobile game?
[D25:9] John: Thanks James! I kept it a secret because I would have been very upset if I had told you about her in advance and then it wouldn't have worked out. I've been working on this for the past few months and I'm really proud of how it's turned out. It's a 2D adventure game with puzzles and exploration. Here's a screenshot.
[D25:9] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a video game with a bunch of different screens
[D25:10] James: John, this sounds great! I'm into 2D adventures with puzzles - like The Legend of Zelda. Can I see it or help with testing it out?
